1-on-1 Consulting Calls

From $149 / 60 minutes

Every rural rental is different, and your strategy should be too. Before our call I personally review your intake form, listing, pricing, and photos so we hit the ground running. You walk away with a clear, prioritized action plan — not a list of possibilities.

What we cover
  • ✓ Pricing & revenue strategy
  • ✓ Listing audit (photos, title, copy)

  • ✓ Guest experience & 5-star reviews
  • ✓ Turnover & operations systems
  • ✓ Messaging & automation
  • ✓ Channel strategy (Airbnb/Vrbo/direct)
  • ✓ Tech stack recommendations
  • ✓ Owner time reduction
  • ✓ New property launch planning
  • ✓ Underperforming property diagnosis
  • ✓ Vendor & maintenance systems
Not included
  • ✗ Legal or tax advice
  • ✗ Direct contact of guests or vendors on your behalf

CabinHost Insiders

Quick, specific situations come up constantly in short-term rental management. This membership gives you direct access to real-world guidance for the day-to-day decisions that come with running a rural STR — without needing to schedule a full call every time.

What you get
  • ✓ Submit questions anytime — get expert answers within 1–2 business days

  • ✓ Private Slack community for networking with other rural hosts
